high_level_description: This image captures a breathtaking view of the night sky, dominated by the Milky Way galaxy. The central focus is the dense cluster of stars and cosmic dust that forms the spiral arms of our galaxy, glowing with a soft white light against the dark backdrop of space. The stars are scattered throughout the image, creating a sense of depth and vastness. The setting appears to be a remote, mountainous area, as suggested by the silhouettes of dark, rugged peaks at the bottom of the frame.
